author: National Geographic
description:
Tom Hiddleston, star of Loki and the Avengers, joins National Geographic to tell the story of Pompeii like you’ve never seen before. Over 1000 years after the famed eruption of Mt. Vesuvius buried the city of Pompeii under ash, Tom digs into the past to find remarkable stories of survival, tracing minute by minute, hour by hour, the decisions made in the chaos and pressure of one of the world’s most infamous natural disasters. Be prepared to never think of Pompeii in the same way again. Pompeii: Out Of Time With Tom Hiddleston is coming soon.
